ticket.title: Screening engine change — release 3
ticket.text: Legacy reference: Legacy Screen. Release changes Screening Engine. Implementation date: 2027-01-15.

decisions.proposer_reason: Screening Engine update affects priority‑payment alert review
decisions.proposer_counter: None
decisions.checker_reason: The changed entity S03 (Screening Engine) is linked in the change_neighborhood to screening execution controls (e.g., C02, C021, C023, C024, C026, C027, C028, C029) which govern the screening process. The target control C032 governs a "priority payment" alert review, which belongs to the "Sanctions alert review" family and is not shown to be reached by S03. Since the functions differ—screening execution vs. alert review—and no edge from S03 to any member of the alert‑review family is visible, the control governs a different function that the changed entity does not reach.
